posts.trend: Wipro, TCS, Infosys push Nifty IT to 33,000 mark
posts.context: One green day in IT stocks turns a colleague who put four thousand rupees into shares into a self-appointed market guru.
posts.angle: Investing four thousand rupees in a single green candle makes your desk neighbour act like he runs the boardroom.

landing_options.line: By 4 PM his profit barely covered two samosas.
At 3:31 PM he went back to fixing a client spreadsheet.
He has been checking the app like it is a newborn baby.
He owns four shares and acts like he signs the layoffs.

slides: Your friend bought 4 shares of an IT giant and now walks like a board member.

2:15 voice note from his desk:
"Bro Nifty IT hit 33,000, software is back, I might hold till retirement, wait let me refresh..."
He invested ₹4,200 on Tuesday.
By 4 PM his profit barely covered two samosas.
posts.caption: Every office bay has one guy checking charts every ten minutes on a four-thousand-rupee position 📊

tweet.setup: My colleague bought four tech shares yesterday and now talks like a fund manager.
tweet.punch: His total profit by market close paid for two canteen samosas.

messages.text: IT index crossing 33k bro. Told you I timed the bottom.
Tera profit 68 rupaye hai. Chai pila de.

posts.rank_verdict: Sharp, affectionate character roast with great numbers, weakened only slightly by slipping into past tense at the end.
